testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed.

decisions: Event ordering is timestamp, source sequence, fixed serialized event-class priority, then incoming feed order.
WallClock is an explicit adapter boundary; SimClock and the synchronous event kernel never read wall time implicitly.
